Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.out.persistence

Class LegacyWalletLifecycleAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.out.persistence.LegacyWalletLifecycleAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
WalletLifecyclePort
@Component public final class LegacyWalletLifecycleAdapter extends Object implements WalletLifecyclePort
Compatibility adapter for the existing persistence/provisioning implementation. The HTTP/application boundary no longer depends on KfeWalletService directly.
